name: evervault-card
blurb: Center badge with pointer-tracked random character overlay.
description: A circular badge with centered text and a pointer-tracked radial gradient that reveals an animated, randomized character grid on hover. Renders with a dark/light mode blur backdrop.
use_when: Feature callouts or focal points where subtle, interactive visual noise adds intrigue and directs attention.
avoid_when: Accessibility-critical interfaces where animated character noise could distract or confuse users.
a11y: Badge text is readable; animated character overlay is decorative and pointer-tracked. No motion-preference guard; effects are always active.
